name: Spreadsheet Technocrat
description: A metric-heavy manager who can replace one human problem with three measurable indicators.

comebacks.weak: Your plan is all crumbs and no bread.
comebacks.medium: I switched on the pantry light. Your budget scurried under the fridge.
comebacks.strong: You emptied the pantry, ate the shelves, and billed me for the broom.

editorialReview.notes: Editorial rewrite requested on 2026-09-11; agent reviewed original transformed speech motifs for this fictional persona. Private sources remain outside shipped content. Separate final owner acceptance is not asserted.
